notes.title: "EASY MODE" has been updated.
notes.content:
'Easy Mode' has been added to 'Jumping Mellow'!

If you are a player who is having difficulty with existing difficulty or is playing Jumping Mellow for the first time, you can now enjoy Jumping Mellow with easier difficulty.



- There is a button at the bottom of the main screen to switch modes.

- Life numbers exist in "EASY MODE." The player is therefore given several chances.

- "EASY MODE" Ranking is independent of "NORMAL MODE".



Have fun playing with Jumping Mellow!

notes.title: Patch note - 2020.04.10
notes.content: An error has been fixed in the swamp block (the block where the character slowly dives) where the jump button is not working.

notes.title: Patch note - 2020.03.26
notes.content: There were opinions that the level of difficulty of the stage was too difficult. So the level of difficulty from stage 1 to 30 was corrected.
